title: Vendor return part search without View shows the access error
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW) is a staff member at {Location-A} whose custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW) has 'Vendor Order Management → View' and 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit', and no 'Part Library & Inventory' permission, not even View.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser or a private window.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW Vendor) exists.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW-01), vendor {Vendor-A}, is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
custom_steps:
1. As {User-B}, go to Parts → Returns.
  2. Start a new return with the control that opens the "Create Return" page.
  3. Pick Vendor {Vendor-A}.
  4. Type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW) in the Part Number lookup.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 and 2: The Returns list opens, and then the "Create Return" page opens, for {User-B}.
  • Step 4: No parts are listed and the application's standard access error shows (the same message the application shows for any page or action the user has no access to).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-N3, S9-N3a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows this. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 10): 'Vendor Order Management → View' and 'Create & Edit', without 'Part Library & Inventory → View'. SV-10822 does not yet carry S9-N3a (the PRD wins). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N3: “Picking parts on a vendor return or a vendor credit needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → View' permission, as it does today. Without it the part search there shows the standard access error.”
  • S9-N3a: “Opening Parts → Returns needs 'Vendor Order Management → View'. Starting a vendor return needs 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'. A role with both and without 'Part Library & Inventory → View' opens a return and gets the S9-N3 access error when it searches for a part.”
